figures.definition_text: Whether any related person has been confirmed by the client for this engagement. 'no' means none were confirmed -- never inferred from a ledger or party name.

findings.title_text: No related person has been confirmed for this engagement
limits_text: Who is a related person under s.40A(2)(b) is a fact the books do not record; payments to such persons cannot be listed until the client names them.
ask_client_text: List the relatives of the proprietor or partners, and any concern in which any of them has a substantial interest, with every payment made to them in the year.
